name: feedback
description: Feedback collection for Hasna-coded apps: a local store, a CLI, an MCP server, an HTTP API, and a TypeScript client.

serviceSurfaces.name: feedback-http-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The HTTP API ships and serves GET /health plus the /v1 routes, but it does not meet the v1 service topology: there is no GET /ready, no GET /version, and no /openapi.json. GET /health also returns { ok, service, version } rather than the contract's { status, version, mode }, and the mode field cannot be filled truthfully until the store moves onto a contract storage engine. Declaring this surface supported today would assert routes that do not exist.

conformance.notes: storage is deliberately absent. The only implemented backend is an append-only JSONL file at ~/.hasna/feedback/feedback.jsonl; storage.mode admits sqlite | postgres only, and this package ships neither a SQLite database nor a PostgreSQL driver. No storage block can be written here that is both schema-valid and true, so this manifest is knowingly non-conformant and repo-conformance reports that as its first failure. The remedy is the storage migration recorded in docs/contract-conformance.md, not an edit to this file.
